A member of the family behind the IDB investment group, he went on to run his own private investment company. He also co-founded Recanati Winery with Uri Shaked, turning a longstanding interest in wine into a business.

long_biography.plain_text:
Lenny Recanati's interest in wine began in his father's garden in Haifa. Jacob Recanati grew grapes and made wine for the household, introducing his son to bottles brought back from travels abroad. Lenny later became a collector, developing relationships that would help him sell his own winery's products internationally.

At wine fairs, Recanati poured tastings himself to learn how visitors responded. A major American importer he knew through collecting helped place the wines in overseas markets. Recanati and partner Uri Shaked also supplied personal capital as production grew. Recanati understood that wine could tie up money for two years before it was ready to sell.

confidence.reason: Full contemporary interview directly describes family influence, personal promotion, importer relationship and owner-financed working capital; no current production figures or quality claims imported.
